2115566670618235202.en_summary: TheTranscript_ quotes $MSFT Microsoft CFO expects ~$170B in FY27 CapEx, with spending accelerating in H2 as delayed capacity comes online. "In Q2, we expect CapEx spend will be over $50B. Therefore, for the calendar year, spend should be ~$170B, due to the 3P capacity delays noted earlier. In the second half of the fiscal year, we currently expect CapEx spend to accelerate, primarily from CPUs—including higher memory and storage costs—and GPUs, as well as the 3P capacity deliveries that shifted to H2. And as we continue to improve the efficiencies of our infrastructure, each dollar of CapEx has the potential to support more revenue and deliver higher returns over time."
2115566670618235202.zh_summary: TheTranscript_ 引用 $MSFT Microsoft CFO 預期 FY27 資本支出約 1700 億美元，下半年因延遲產能上線而加速支出。「在 Q2，我們預期資本支出將超過 500 億美元。因此，由於先前提到的 3P 產能延遲，日曆年支出應約為 1700 億美元。在財年下半年，我們目前預期資本支出將加速，主要來自 CPU（包括更高的記憶體和儲存成本）和 GPU，以及轉移到 H2 的 3P 產能交付。隨著我們持續改善基礎設施效率，每一美元資本支出都有潛力支持更多營收並隨時間帶來更高回報。」

ticker_notes.MSFT: FY27 資本支出約 1700 億美元，下半年加速

2115565615239086227.en_summary: TheTranscript_ notes $MSFT CFO throwing some shade on the FCF -ve $META and $GOOGL: "Given our strong business performance, we expect to continue to remain free cash flow positive, and in FY27, to complement cash generated by the business and preserve financial flexibility, we will access additional sources of funding when we believe it is attractive to do so."
2115565615239086227.zh_summary: TheTranscript_ 指出 $MSFT CFO 對自由現金流負值的 $META 和 $GOOGL 有所影射：「鑒於我們強勁的業務表現，我們預期將繼續保持自由現金流為正，並在 FY27，為補充業務產生的現金並保持財務靈活性，我們將在認為有吸引力時獲取額外資金來源。」

ticker_notes.MSFT: 預期保持自由現金流為正，對比 META 和 GOOGL
